name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: Agent Launchpad with a durable JetStream coordination middleware proof.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:relay: npm run check && npm run verify:relay-live && npm run verify:relay-restart && npm run verify:relay-cancel && npm run verify:relay-disconnect && npm run verify:relay-reuse && npm run verify:relay-sse
